4 Days Lake Naivasha Maasai Mara Safari

Package overview

Embark on an unforgettable 4-day adventure exploring the serene waters of Lake Naivasha and the iconic wildlife-rich plains of the Masai Mara. Witness the spectacular diversity of Kenya’s wildlife, from graceful giraffes and zebras to the majestic Big Five. This safari combines the tranquility of lakeside scenery with thrilling game drives in one of Africa’s most famous national parks.

  • Lake Naivasha
  • Boat Safari: Cruise the freshwater lake for close encounters with hippos that bob on the surface and vast colonies of majestic birds, including African Fish Eagles.
  • Crescent Island Walking Safari: Enjoy a guided walk among grazing animals (giraffes, zebras, and various antelopes) in a safe, open environment—a unique highlight where you are on foot with the wildlife.
  • Great Rift Valley Views: The drive to Naivasha provides spectacular, sweeping views as you descend into the valley floor.
  • Masai Mara
  • The Great Migration (Seasonal): If traveling between July and October, witness the epic river crossings of millions of wildebeest and zebra across the Mara River.
  • Big Cat Sightings: The Mara is renowned for guaranteed sightings of lions, cheetahs, and leopards—it is one of the best places in the world to see predators in action.
  • Big Five & More: A near-certainty to spot the "Big Five" (lion, leopard, elephant, rhino, buffalo) and countless other species.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi - Lake Naivasha

Depart Nairobi early in the morning and drive to Lake Naivasha , located in the Great Rift Valley. Arrive and check in at your lakeside lodge. Enjoy an afternoon boat ride on Lake Naivasha , spotting hippos, giraffes, and a variety of bird species. Optional visit to Crescent Island for a guided walking safari among free-roaming wildlife. Dinner and overnight at your lodge by the lake.

02Day 2 | Lake Naivasha - Masai Mara

After breakfast, drive through scenic landscapes towards the Masai Mara National Reserve . Arrive at your lodge or camp and check in. Embark on an afternoon game drive in the Mara, home to lions, elephants, cheetahs, and more. Watch the sunset over the savannah before returning to the lodge for dinner and overnight stay.

03Day 3 | Full Day Masai Mara

Start early with a morning game drive to spot predators and other wildlife during their most active hours. Return to the lodge for breakfast, then relax or enjoy optional activities such as a hot air balloon safari (at extra cost). Another afternoon game drive allows you to cover different parts of the Mara for diverse wildlife sightings. Dinner and overnight at the lodge.

04Day 4 | Masai Mara - Nairobi

Optional early morning game drive for a last chance to see the Big Five. Breakfast at the lodge before departing back to Nairobi. Arrive in Nairobi by mid to late afternoon, concluding your safari adventure. Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.

What's excluded

  • Items of personal nature (e.g., jackets, binoculars, cameras)

  • Travel insurance or international medical cover

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
